blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang has already left the country through the “backdoor,” Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla confirmed on Tuesday. “Backdoor siya (nakabas),” Remulla said in an interview in Makati City. (He used the backdoor.) Remulla declined to provide further details on when and how
